Container.Name: gluetun
Container.Overview: gluetun, the VPN client companion traffic goes through. Fill in the VPN settings yourself: Lodestar never asks for or stores them. While the VPN is down, its firewall blocks new connections, and Lodestar's post-rules stop connections that were already open from leaving outside the VPN. Before you start it, save Lodestar's post-rules file at the Post-rules path, as the Lodestar user guide shows (chapter 3, "Close gluetun's gap when the VPN drops"). Without the file, gluetun won't start. Applying it replaces a container or template you already have with the same name: check first. Create the Docker network first: Unraid starts a container on a network it doesn't know with none.

Config.Name: Post-rules
Config.Description: Lodestar's post-rules file, read-only. Save it here before you start gluetun.
